compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a webpage from BlackBerry's legal section, specifically the BBM Terms of Service. The main content includes a "Notice of Change" with the last update dated 2015-02-02. The notice explains that previously, the BBM Terms of Service had multiple versions tailored for different countries to comply with local laws and requirements. Users had to select their country to view the applicable terms. To streamline this process, BlackBerry has consolidated these provisions into a single "global" version of the BBM Terms of Service. The notice also mentions that while some provisions are found in other sections, the majority can be found in the new section 24, titled "Jurisdiction." The screen also features a navigation bar at the top with a URL and a menu icon.
